Untrusted content: agentbit_route, agentbit.counterparty_risk, agentbit.counterparty_verify, agentbit.email_deliverability, agentbit.feed_read, agentbit.maps_search, agentbit.reddit_search, agentbit.shopping_search, agentbit.url_threat_check, agentbit.web_brief, agentbit.web_extract, agentbit.web_json, agentbit.web_search, agentbit.wiki_facts · Private data: agentbit_route, agentbit.agent_counter, agentbit.agent_list, agentbit.agent_memory, agentbit.company_enrich, agentbit.contract_audit, agentbit.convert_xml_json, agentbit.counterparty_verify, agentbit.crypto_trader_kit, agentbit.defi_yields, agentbit.dns_inspect, agentbit.domain_dossier, agentbit.email_deliverability, agentbit.financial_document, agentbit.hash_hmac, agentbit.ip_intel, agentbit.jwt_decode, agentbit.onchain_gas, agentbit.onchain_read, agentbit.sec_filings, agentbit.token_price, agentbit.token_risk, agentbit.url_threat_check, agentbit.uuid_generate, agentbit.wallet_counterparties, agentbit.wallet_dossier, agentbit.wallet_profile, agentbit.wallet_screen, agentbit.wallet_transactions · Public sink: agentbit.ai_ask, agentbit.counterparty_risk, agentbit.dns_inspect, agentbit.domain_dossier, agentbit.email_deliverability, agentbit.hash_hmac, agentbit.news_search, agentbit.reddit_search, agentbit.web_search · Destructive: agentbit_route, agentbit.agent_counter, agentbit.agent_memory, agentbit.counterparty_risk, agentbit.financial_document, agentbit.vat_check.
